FIRST A DDENDUM OF THE JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENT DATED 28 TH DECEMBER, 202 0 
 This first addendum (the “First A ddendum ” ) of the Joint Venture Agreement dated 28 th December, 202 0 (the “ Joint Venture ” ) is made and entered into Lahore on this the ___ day of January, 2023 ( “Effective Date” ) by and between: 
 
 ZAMEEN AXIX (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at 94-B/1, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg – III, Lahore hereinafter referred to as “ ZAMEEN ” through its authorized representative which constitutes the First Part; 
 AND 
 EARTHLINK DEVELOPMENTS LLP , a limited liability partnership firm incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at First Floor, Plaza No. 37, Ascon Heights, Civic Centre, Phase IV, Bahria Town, Islamabad hereinafter referred to as the “ Earthlink ” through its authorized representatives which constitutes the Second Part. 
 ( Zameen and Earthlink shall hereinafter individually referred to as the “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”) 
 
 WHEREAS : 
 
 Zameen and Earthlink entered into the Joint Venture to undertake real estate construction, development, marketing and sale project(s) through EDZD Developers a partnership firm established under the laws of Pakistan ; and 
 
 In light of the above and pursuant to Clause No. 19.4 of the Joint Venture, the Parties agree to revise, amend and supplement the Construction Management Company in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 The First A ddendum shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 Clause 7.2 of the Joint Venture, is hereby revised, restated and replaced as follows: 
 “7.2 Construction Management Company 
 The Construction of the Project will be supervised and managed by the Project Management Committee through Zameen Developments (PVT) Limited (the “ Construction Management Company” ). In this regard, the Parties agree and understand that the Construction Management Company will enter into a construction management agreement with the Joint Venture recording the terms and conditions pursuant to which the construction management services will be provided for the Project (the “ Construction Management Agreement ”). The terms and conditions of the Construction Management Agreement shall include, inter alia: 
 Manage, coordinate and oversee the Construction and development of the Project, 
 Coordinate and liaise with contractors, sub-contractors or any other service providers during the Construction of the Project; 
 Devise and implement effective mechanisms and systems for maintaining constant and regular checks on the pace and quality or the Works at the Project Land; 
 C oordination of all Works to be performed for the purposes of execution or the Project; 
 Ensure the Construction of the Project conforms with the Project Approvals. Project Master Plan and all applicable regulations, rules and laws; 
 Ensure strict compliance of the Schedule of Works by all contractors and sub-contractors; 
 Carry out continuous inspection of the Works at the Project Land where Construction is in progress; 
 Ensure all Construction is in accordance with the industry standards and conduct quality control and verification; and Perform all other incidental activities relating to the Project. ” 
 This Addendum shall be read as an integral part of the Project Agreement. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Joint Venture shall bear the same meaning in this First Addendum , unless otherwise specified. 
 Any conflicting terms in the Joint Venture shall be deemed amended appropriately to give effect to the intention of the Parties herein. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Joint Venture shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of this First A ddendum shall prevail. 
 This First A ddendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same document. 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First A ddendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses. 
 
 SIGNATORIES:
